{"edits":[{"new":"    def __setstate__(self, state: Any) -> None:
        if isinstance(state, dict):
            if "_version" in state:
                # 25.0 state
                v = state["_version"]
                self._epoch = v.epoch
                self._release = v.release
                self._dev = v.dev
                self._pre = v.pre
                self._post = v.post
                self._local = v.local
            else:
                # 26.0+ state
                for key, value in state.items():
                    if key.startswith("_") and key not in ("_hash_cache", "_key_cache"):
                        # Use object.__setattr__ to bypass __slots__ if necessary, 
                        # but Version has __slots__ and these are in it.
                        setattr(self, key, value)
        
        self._key_cache = None
        self._hash_cache = None
